self_review: All ten keys appear once and match the requested order. Five recognizably distinct enclosed pilot portraits avoid selecting a full A/B/C mech; five landscape vignettes distinguish desert, canyon, orchard, forested ridge and dry pale dunes. Portrait fur and cockpit detailing lean more naturalistic than the chunky construction target. Cropped cockpit glass is subtle; no claim of model enclosure verification. No regeneration used.
